comparison.objective: Push selected reject cartons from a moving conveyor without disturbing good cartons; candidate commissions a damper on an isolated axis.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed non-prehensile lateral pushing differs from small-tool insertion, threaded locking, fine collar rotation, and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both rejects on the table and good cartons preserved throughout; candidate requires two safe, repeatable damped stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Moving-line timing and selective pushing do not duplicate adjustment or force-controlled fastening.
